subject.title: fix(sqlite): serialize offline maintenance with gateway

question: Should state-directory ownership remain mandatory even when OPENCLAW_ALLOW_MULTI_GATEWAY is set, accepting that previously tolerated same-state deployments will now fail the second Gateway at startup?
rationale: The repository policy and SQLite safety evidence favor one owner per state directory, but this intentionally changes an existing environment override's effective behavior for some deployed configurations.

options.title: Enforce state isolation
options.body: Land the fail-closed state lock and treat separate state directories as a required invariant for every concurrent Gateway.

options.title: Preserve an explicit escape hatch
options.body: Add a separately named, documented unsafe override with clear warnings and targeted compatibility tests for operators who knowingly share state.

recommendation.title: Enforce state isolation
recommendation.body: Land the fail-closed state lock and treat separate state directories as a required invariant for every concurrent Gateway.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current design, are assigned to the PR, and supplied the cross-platform safety and recovery evidence needed to calibrate this compatibility choice.
